crossRefs.note: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which…
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t…
being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder…
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to…
even he shall build Yahweh’s temple; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule on his throne; and he shall be…
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

translations.web: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
translations.bsb: Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil, but the counselors of peace have joy.
translations.kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
translations.asv: Deceit is in the heart of them that devise evil; But to the counsellors of peace is joy.
